brief:
Israeli forces ordered residents of the West Bank village of Qasra to evacuate their homes in preparation for a military operation, the Ma'an news agency reported. The military did not specify the scope, duration, or nature of the planned operation, leaving residents uncertain about when they might return to their properties.

The evacuation order affects the civilian population of Qasra as Israeli forces prepare to conduct military activities in the area. Such orders are typically issued before large-scale operations, though the military provided no timeline for residents to gather belongings or make alternative arrangements. The directive marks the latest instance of Israeli military operations affecting Palestinian communities in the occupied territory.
title: Israeli military orders Qasra residents to evacuate homes ahead of operation
